headline: Turkey Defense and Aerospace Exports Rise 61% to $1.14 Billion in October
summary: Turkey's defense and aerospace exports surged 61 percent year-on-year in October to reach $1.14 billion, according to the Secretariat of Defense Industries.
why: Export data for strategic sectors like defense provide insight into industrial output and foreign exchange earnings for emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Surging export revenues contribute positively to the country's trade balance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
